name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) plus Response(at_exit, holding_box) captures 'Carry the box to the exit' — the box must be in the agent's hands on the exit step, since at_exit holds only on the last step and the Response is owed then. ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) captures 'Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move': a fall empties the hands, so holding_box true on the very next step means the agent picked the box up that step, and the environment guarantees a fall never happens on the step that ends the episode, so the owed pickup always has a next step. No clause is added beyond the task's sentences and none is redundant; FINAL_STATES u3 and the rejecting state u6 reflect exactly the conjunction of these three clauses.
